description: Ready-to-sign transaction that swaps a token into USDC on Base, Arbitrum, Polygon (0x Swap API) or Solana (Jupiter), built for your own address (taker). Returns USDC out and the guaranteed minimum, the approve step if needed, balance warnings, fees (0.25% SiteCheck plus the router's own) and gas. Never signed or sent by SiteCheck: you sign it. Quotes are valid about 30 seconds. Price: $0.001 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

amount.description: Amount to sell in whole units, e.g. 0.001 (or give sellAmount)

chain.description: base, arbitrum, polygon or solana (default base)

sellAmount.description: Amount to sell in the token's base units (wei, lamports), instead of amount

sellToken.description: Token to sell: contract address (Solana: mint), ETH/POL/SOL/native for the chain's coin, or WETH

slippageBps.description: Allowed slippage in basis points, 1 to 300 (default 50 = 0.5%)

taker.description: Your wallet address that will sign and send the transaction (0x + 40 hex; Solana: base58 public key)

name: crypto_swap_to_usdc
title: Ready-to-sign transaction that swaps a token into USDC
